guardrail:
No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no user interface, no windows, no icons, no logos, no watermarks, no captions, no subtitles, no signage. Every surface stays abstract and unreadable.

Audio: silence.

shots.prompt: Cinematic macro shot in a dark room before dawn. A monitor sits at a steep oblique angle, its screen a soft out-of-focus wash of deep blue-green light: pure bokeh, no shapes, no characters. Fine dust drifts slowly through the light. The camera pushes in a few centimetres, very slow, with faint handheld drift. Near-black background, a single green accent glow. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic, fine film grain. Mood: quiet, focused, unhurried.

Slow parallax pull-back, panels at the edges falling gently out of focus. Near-black background, a single green accent. Anamorphic bokeh, fine film grain, no lens flare, no starburst.
